operating_notes.text: Consolidated global order book stands at ₹25,350 Crore (approx. US$ 2.6 billion) as of May 2026, to be executed during FY27 and FY28.
Completed capability enhancement of Anjar spiral facility into a hybrid facility and commissioned additional coating facility at Bhopal (3 million sq. m. p.a.).
Incorporated step-down subsidiary 'Welspun Global Jordan' in Jordan with an initial capital of Jordanian Dinar 50,000.
Consolidated order book stood at over ₹42,000 crore as on August 20, 2026, providing revenue visibility over 18-24 months.
PBILDT/tonne for pipes and steel business increased from ₹11,922/tonne in FY25 to ₹14,413/tonne in FY26.

US subsidiary Welspun Tubular LLC secured an order of ~₹5,500 crore for a Permian natural gas pipeline project, raising the global order book to an all-time high of approx. USD 5.25 billion (~₹50,000 crore).

timeline.summary: Welspun Corp bagged a ₹700 Cr LSAW pipe order from its US facility, taking its consolidated global order book to ₹25,350 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,312.56 Cr, net profit ₹371.46 Cr.
Welspun Corp Limited shared Q4 FY 2025-26 earnings call recording on its website via **Kamal Rathi (ACS-18182)** on May 22, 2026.
Welspun Corp submitted the Q4 and FY26 earnings call transcript to the stock exchanges on May 25, 2026.
2026-07-30: Welspun Corp released the Q1FY27 earnings call transcript.
Welspun Corp incorporated a new step-down wholly owned subsidiary, Welspun Global Jordan, in Jordan.
CARE Ratings reaffirmed Welspun Corp's ratings at CARE AA+ (Stable) and CARE A1+, withdrawing unraised ₹784 Cr long-term bank facilities.

2026-10-23: Welspun Corp's US subsidiary secured an order valued at ~₹5,500 crore to supply coated line pipes for a US natural gas pipeline project, pushing its global order book to a record ~₹50,000 crore.
